title: Red Hat Security Advisory: squid:4 security update
description: A security update for Squid 4, a high-performance proxy caching server, addresses a vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-61642. This flaw involves HTTP request smuggling via the Transfer-Encoding header. Red Hat has issued an important security advisory for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8, providing updated packages to fix this issue. The advisory includes detailed instructions for applying the update. No CVSS score is provided in the advisory, but the severity is rated as important by Red Hat Product Security.
